A brotherhood of exiled navigators who burn their star charts after every crossing, keeping the only surviving routes beneath their skin.

The earliest verified account was recovered in The Ashen Reach during survey cycle 731. Its original transmission carried the seal of the Exilis expedition, but several passages had been deliberately removed. A subsequent reconnaissance mission confirmed the central observation and recovered physical evidence now held in vault 001. The discrepancy between the first report and later testimony remains unresolved.

Field agents are instructed to observe from established trade routes. Diplomatic contact requires two independent witnesses and a complete record of every exchange. The current classification reflects the most recent verified encounter; absence of a new report must never be interpreted as evidence that the anomaly has ceased.
